label: Gala

provenance.incarnation: Richard Ames in original MGS2, gaunt middle-aged pale man with hollow cheeks, long lined angular face, gray swept-back wavy hair loosely gathered behind neck, stern heavy brow, natural bare hands; no sunglasses, no beard invented, no younger or different series character. Original CQC Gala clothes and combat animations, not official commercial costume.

sources.scope: Official Shinkawa original-incarnation head/partial upper-body art; gala lower-body garments are original adaptation.

Official original MGS2 SOCOM manual/UI small silhouette; red is UI outline, not gun material. Draw dark gunmetal original SOCOM, no rifle or imported MGS3 M1911A1. Period CQC simulation kit, not attested personal canon ownership.
